claudePrompt.title: KinFlo OS two-frame design critique
claudePrompt.prompt: Review two KinFlo OS frames as a senior product designer: the super-admin command frame and the client-site studio frame. Use the attached sanitized packet and public design references only. Produce: 1. three non-negotiable design principles, 2. a frame-by-frame critique, 3. five provider-light UI deltas that can be implemented without live Convex, provider writes, secrets, or client sharing, 4. mobile risks at 390px, and 5. a do-not-change list for safety gates. Do not ask for secrets, credentials, production data, or raw private files.

ingestionRules: Do not mark Claude Code review complete until the CLI returns a successful response.
Summarize Claude recommendations; do not commit raw private transcript text.
Classify every recommendation as accepted, rejected, or deferred.
Convert accepted recommendations into scoped provider-light backlog items before implementation.

Reject any recommendation that enables hosted Convex, generated API imports, provider writes, tenant launch, public publish, invite delivery, lead writes, domain verification, campaign sends, AI provider calls, production import, or client sharing before the human gate.
